The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the ninth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S09|Pokémon: Battle Frontier]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Pokémon Season 9 Super Wallet== [[File:Season 9 Super Wallet Region 4.jpg|thumb|Season 9 Super Wallet]] {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing [[Super Wallet]]s to celebrate the {{pkmn|10th Anniversary}}. The Season 9 Super Wallet was released by Magna Pacific (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on March 4, 2009. It contains 10 discs with 47 episodes across them combined, and one bonus disc with ''[[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon]]''. Its catalogue number is DSW12994. Its discs are designed to resemble a [[Luxury Ball]], except the bonus disc, which is designed to resemble a [[Premier Ball]]. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. ===Contents=== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Emerald}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Emerald}}" ! The Season 9 DigiPack disc set was released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on March 2, 2011 and in New Zealand on May 12, 2011. It contains six discs with 47 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13191. Its discs are designed to resemble a [[Luxury Ball]]. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/980903292007738 on July 14, 2016] and in JB Hi-Fi stores [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/1034172803347453 on September 21, 2016] to celebrate the [[Pokémon 20th Anniversary]]. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case on April 2, 2014 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5393. This disc set was once again re-released by [https://shock.com.au/ Shock Entertainment] in Australia on June 2, 2021 and in New Zealand on July 21, 2021 with a different cover and the catalogue number KAL5660B. ===Contents=== Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
